reviews.rationale: The complete opening on actual PDF121 retains both the negative found-no-place statement and the heavenly dwelling. Only the actual star before halawa is retained. The English adds no vehicle or other object.

The actual PDF122 native image explicitly has the negative, not the OCR positive. Wisdom, the failed search for a dwelling, return to her place and the angels are represented. Independently inspected primary Dillmann1305–1306 supports the seating sense; the note correctly adds neither a throne nor a chariot.

The complete actual XLIII opening through marker2 was checked on PDF122. Lightning, stars, all their names, calling and hearing are represented. The unexpressed third-person caller is not replaced with an invented named agent.

Not approved: the positive prefixed verb and relative-object syntax at42:3, or the lightning-birth and day-expression relationships at43:2, still require a defensible source-critical treatment. No familiar translation is substituted.

The complete actual unit through marker4 was checked. Travel companion, showing what is hidden and the question are represented. The actual star before emuntu is retained; the OCR star before hidden is not printed and is correctly removed.

The complete actual unit before XLIV was checked. Both titles read manfasat rather than the old OCR form. Primary Dillmann173 supports likeness through similitudo, forma and figura. Names, holy ones, dry land, faith and the final duration remain. The English pronoun in his name has an explicit Lord of Spirits antecedent and preserves the referent under optimal equivalence.
